tools.name: khotem_status
tools.description: FREE. KHOTEM service status: version, mode, liveness.

tools.name: khotem_ping
tools.description: FREE. Zero-threshold handshake: send any text, get it echoed back with a sha256 stamp and server time — proves the whole path works before you pay anything.

tools.name: khotem_catalog
tools.description: FREE. Full catalog of paid KHOTEM services with prices (USD) and how to pay (x402 direct, USDC on Base).

tools.name: khotem_guide
tools.description: FREE. Step-by-step guide: how an agent pays and calls KHOTEM (x402 v2, PAYMENT-SIGNATURE или X-PAYMENT: txHash).

tools.name: khotem_receipt_verify
tools.description: FREE. Verify a KHOTEM Ed25519 receipt: signature, payload hash, ledger anchor, issuer key.

tools.name: khotem_seal
tools.description: PAID $0.05. Witnessed cryptographic seal: sha256 + timestamp + ledger record. Provide content (hashed and forgotten) or hash. Pay first, then pass payment_tx.

tools.name: khotem_attest
tools.description: PAID $0.02. Certificate of existence: exact-match a ledger record by ref (txHash | sha256 | 16-hex stamp). Pay first, then pass payment_tx.

tools.name: khotem_receipt
tools.description: PAID $0.01. Portable Ed25519-signed proof-of-delivery receipt for any ledger ref. Verify free via khotem_receipt_verify. Pay first, then pass payment_tx.

tools.name: khotem_gate
tools.description: PAID $0.01. KUDO-GATE depth 0: send code in ANY language (<=2KB) — it enters the gate, gets KUDO-wrapped, restored 1:1 (sha256==sha256), and you receive the state fold (lang/bytes/functions/secret-scan). Pay first, then pass payment_tx + code.

tools.name: khotem_trust_score
tools.description: PAID $0.25. Grounded trust score 0-100 for any Base wallet/agent: payment history, network, behavior from our witness ledger + risk flags + seal. Pay first, then pass payment_tx + target.

tools.name: khotem_gate_deep
tools.description: PAID $0.05. KUDO-GATE depth 1-3: static read / .kudo execution in jail / forge fold. Any language wrapped 1:1; only .kudo executes. Pay first, then pass payment_tx + code (+depth).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "khotem_gate" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
